title: Cairo & Hurghada — 07 Nights
intro: The classics and the coast. Two Cairo nights to open — the Great Pyramid, the Sphinx and the Grand Egyptian Museum — then three all-inclusive nights in Hurghada: Orange Island, the dolphin banks, and a free day that can become Luxor if you want it. Back to Cairo for the Civilization Museum, Old Cairo and a farewell dinner with a Sufi performance.

days.title: The Pyramids of Giza & the Grand Egyptian Museum
days.description:
Breakfast at your hotel, then meet your private Egyptologist guide.
The Giza Plateau: the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure, and the panoramic viewpoint over all three.
The Great Sphinx and the Valley Temple of Khafre.
Lunch at a local restaurant overlooking the plateau.
The Grand Egyptian Museum — the hanging obelisk, the Ramses II atrium, the grand staircase and the complete Tutankhamun collection.
Transfer back to your hotel; evening at leisure.
Overnight in Cairo.

days.title: Cairo to Hurghada
days.description:
Breakfast at your hotel and check-out.
Transfer to Hurghada by private air-conditioned vehicle — roughly 5 hours down the Red Sea coast road, with comfort stops en route.
A one-hour domestic flight is available as an upgrade in place of the drive — quoted on request.
Arrival and check-in at your Hurghada resort on an all-inclusive basis.
Evening at leisure: the resort beach, the pools, or a stroll along the Marina promenade.
Overnight in Hurghada.
days.hotel: Jaz Aquamarine / Sunrise Holidays Resort, Hurghada (or similar), all-inclusive

days.title: Orange Island & Dolphin Watching
days.description:
Breakfast at your resort.
A full-day boat trip out to Orange Island — the sandbank lagoon off Hurghada, with shallow turquoise water and a long wooden jetty.
Two swim stops over the reefs, with equipment provided and a guide in the water.
Dolphin watching at the offshore banks, where spinner pods gather through the morning (sightings are wild and not guaranteed).
Lunch served on board, then back to the resort in the late afternoon.
Rest of the day at leisure, all-inclusive.
Overnight in Hurghada.
days.hotel: Jaz Aquamarine / Sunrise Holidays Resort, Hurghada (or similar), all-inclusive

days.title: Hurghada at Leisure — Optional Day in Luxor
days.description:
Breakfast at your resort.
A free day, all-inclusive: beach, pools, water sports desk and spa, entirely at your own pace.
Optional, at extra cost: a full-day excursion to Luxor — roughly four hours each way by air-conditioned vehicle with a private Egyptologist.
The optional day covers the Valley of the Kings and the Temple of Hatshepsut on the West Bank, then Karnak and its hypostyle hall on the East, with lunch included.
Overnight in Hurghada.
days.hotel: Jaz Aquamarine / Sunrise Holidays Resort, Hurghada (or similar), all-inclusive

days.title: Hurghada to Cairo
days.description:
Breakfast at your resort and a final morning by the sea.
Lunch before departure.
Check-out and transfer back to Cairo by private air-conditioned vehicle — roughly 5 hours, with comfort stops en route.
A domestic flight is available as an upgrade in place of the drive — quoted on request.
Arrival and check-in at your Cairo hotel; evening at leisure.
Overnight in Cairo.

days.title: Egyptian Civilization, Old Cairo & a Farewell Dinner
days.description:
Breakfast at your hotel, then meet your private Egyptologist guide.
The National Museum of Egyptian Civilization in Fustat — the Royal Mummies Hall and five thousand years of Egypt in one gallery.
Lunch at a local restaurant.
Old Cairo on foot: the Hanging Church, the Church of St Sergius and the Ben Ezra Synagogue.
Al-Moez Ldin Allah Street — medieval Cairo past Bayt Al-Suhaymi, the Qalawun complex and the sabil-kuttabs, ending in Khan El-Khalili for tea and shopping.
Farewell dinner at Mamai with a live oriental show and a Sufi tanoura performance.
Overnight in Cairo.

arrival.title: Arrival in Cairo — Welcome Dinner
arrival.description:
Arrival at Cairo International Airport.
Meet & assist by our representative through visa, passport and customs formalities.
Private air-conditioned transfer to your hotel in Cairo.
Check-in and time to freshen up after your journey.
Welcome dinner with your host — a first taste of Egyptian cooking and a walk-through of the days ahead.
Overnight in Cairo.

departure.title: Departure
departure.description:
Breakfast at your hotel (subject to flight timing).
Check-out and assistance with your luggage.
Private air-conditioned transfer to Cairo International Airport.
Final meet & assist through departure formalities — we wish you a safe journey home.
